C0121.title: Tongli IP | Exploring Anti-Unfair Competition Law Approaches to Platform Governance of Traffic Fraud
C0121.summary: The article analyzes the harm of traffic fraud to platform ecosystems, noting that in 2023, abnormal ad exposure accounted for 23.9% and abnormal clicks 20.4%. It cites the Tencent v. Ant Help Platform case, revealing how ad fraud severs the virtuous cycle between quality content and user engagement, undermining advertisers' value assessment.

references.title: Tongli Intellectual Property | Exploring the Anti-Unfair Competition Law Approach to Platform Governance of Fake Traffic Fraud_Tencent News
